headline: Fee credits and refunds for rain-outs and canceled events, a Free Little Pantry at Fort Hill Park, and youth league field requests.
summary: Requests include flag football and tournament fees, pavilion rentals, and rain-out credits. Other items cover a fundraiser, a bike race cancellation, and changes to Finn Field and McNamara Field.
items: Sabeeh Ehsan: credits for September rain-outs of $100, $75, $50, and $100
Ava Spies: permission to start a Free Little Pantry at Fort Hill Park
Catherine Apollo: refund request for canceled September 26 event
Joseph Bova: adult flag football at Gage Field I and II on November 29, 2026, 10am-2pm, $100 total
Larry Benjamin: flag football tournament at South Common Purtell Multipurpose Field on November 27, 2026, 9am-5pm, $225, 100 people max
Hamim Hasan: fundraiser for LHS at Shedd Park Pavilion on November 8, 2026, 12pm-4pm, $200 total fee
Joe Cady: cancel bike races and waive unpaid fee on his account
Adrianna Paquin: birthday party at Shedd Park Pavilion on November 29, 2026, 1pm-5pm, $200 total fee
Matt LeLacheur, LYBSL: donate cost of McNamara Field renovations and convert Finn Field to a multipurpose field for baseball and softball
location: Mayor’s Reception Room, 375 Merrimack St. 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852

2.) Ava Spies – Community Food Pantry 
Fort Hill Park  
Hoping to gain permission to start up a Free Little Pantry in the Rogers Fort Hill / 
 Belvidere area of Lowell. The project would be a small structure where community 
 members can take what they need / give what they can, including pantry food items and 
 other household necessities.
